Callout.Name: Heat Exhaustion
Callout.Message: Person collapsed in the heat, no shade nearby.

Script.Line: I have been out in it since the morning. No shade, no water.
I stopped feeling hot a while ago. Now I am cold, which makes no sense.
I am not going to hospital. I just need to sit for a minute.

Callout.Patient: I just need to sit down for a minute. I am fine.

Lines.Approach: They have been out in it all day and there is no shade where they are.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
